summary.platform: WordPress + Yoast SEO, Cloudflare CDN, PHP 8.2
data_limitations: No Google API key: CrUX field Core Web Vitals, GSC indexation, and GA4 traffic not available
No Moz/Bing/DataForSEO: backlink and live SERP data not available (Common Crawl tier only)
Headless browser egress blocked in audit sandbox: no live screenshots; mobile assessed from rendered HTML
top_findings: Index bloat: lead-gen, thank-you, and legacy/duplicate pages are all index,follow
Book pages have no Book/Product schema (biggest structured-data miss for a book seller)
Most AI crawlers (GPTBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Apple, Meta) are blocked
Yoast title template broken on many pages (titles end in ' -' with empty brand)
Missing H1 on programmatic posts and the blog index; large volume of thin templated listicles
quick_wins: Fix /reading-guides/ canonical (points to a __trashed redirecting URL)
Set WordPress Site Address to https:// so sitemaps stop emitting http:// URLs
noindex lead-gen/thank-you/old pages and drop them from the sitemap
Repair the Yoast title template so titles end with '— Phillip Strang'
Add llms.txt; decide AI-crawler citation policy

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS enforced; http->https, www->non-www, /index.php all 301 to canonical host
Strong security headers: HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options
Valid robots.txt and Yoast XML sitemap index (1765 URLs)
Cloudflare CDN + WordPress caching plugin active

findings.title: Index bloat: low-value pages indexable
findings.description: All sampled pages are index,follow including /free-book/, /thank-you/, /welcome-aboard/, /join-my-arc-team/, /du-thank-you-*/ and -old variants (all 200).
findings.recommendation: Set noindex,follow on funnel/utility pages and remove them from the XML sitemap.

findings.title: Duplicate / legacy pages live and indexable
findings.description: /about/ vs /about-2/ (13 words), /complete-book-list/ vs /book-list-old/ vs /my-books/, /di-tremayne-series/ vs /di-tremayne-series-2/, /phillip-strang-crime-fiction-author-old/.
findings.recommendation: 301 each duplicate to its canonical winner and delete the orphan.

findings.title: Canonical points to a __trashed redirecting URL
findings.description: /reading-guides/ canonical = https://phillipstrang.com/series__trashed/reading-guides/ which 301-redirects (WordPress trashed-slug artifact).
findings.recommendation: Set the canonical to the live self URL https://phillipstrang.com/reading-guides/.

findings.title: Sitemap and robots reference http:// URLs
findings.description: sitemap_index.xml and child sitemaps emit <loc>http://...; robots Sitemap directive is http://. Site serves https.
findings.recommendation: Set WordPress Address/Site Address to https:// so Yoast emits https URLs.

findings.title: Crawl scale vs content value
findings.description: 1,643 posts dominated by templated listicles strain crawl budget and quality signals.
findings.recommendation: Prune/consolidate thin templated posts (see Content).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: First-party author E-E-A-T; 814-word /about/ with real bio and Person schema
Useful, well-structured 'books in order' reading-order pages with covers + buy links
Hand-written, compelling meta descriptions on money pages

findings.title: Programmatic listicle content at scale (thin-content risk)
findings.description: ~1,643 templated 'best X novels' / 'best Y authors set in Z' posts; depth ranges from 3,885 words down to ~477 for a 4-item topic.
findings.recommendation: Audit posts by depth/engagement; consolidate or noindex+improve the thinnest 20-30%; ensure each targets a distinct query.

findings.title: Thin/empty pages indexed
findings.description: /about-2/ = 13 words (empty duplicate); /dci-isaac-cook-series/ = 132 words with auto meta; /my-books/ = 164 words.
findings.recommendation: Expand, merge, or noindex thin pages.

findings.title: Auto-generated meta descriptions on series/category pages
findings.description: /dci-isaac-cook-series/ description is a body-derived mid-sentence snippet.
findings.recommendation: Write unique meta descriptions for all series and category pages.

findings.title: Competitor-author pages need original value + back-links
findings.description: Pages targeting Rankin/Cleeves/etc. capture intent but must add curation and link back to Strang's series to convert borrowed traffic.
findings.recommendation: Add original notes and internal links from each to relevant Strang series.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Canonical tags + breadcrumbs sitewide
Strong homepage internal linking (~37 internal links)
Open Graph + Twitter Card on homepage
Descriptive keyword-aligned titles on key pages

findings.title: Yoast title template broken (empty brand suffix)
findings.description: Titles render as 'About -', 'Free Book -', '...in 2025 -', 'DCI Isaac Cook Series -' with a dangling separator and no site name.
findings.recommendation: Fix Yoast Search Appearance templates so titles end consistently with '— Phillip Strang'.

findings.title: Missing H1 on programmatic posts and blog index
findings.description: /best-selling-hard-boiled-mystery-novels-in-2025/ (3,885 words) and /blog/ have 0 H1; /best-cozy.../ has 1.
findings.recommendation: Ensure exactly one descriptive H1 per page; fix the post/archive templates.

findings.title: Missing/auto meta descriptions
findings.description: /about-2/ has no meta description; series pages use auto snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add unique meta descriptions; resolve /about-2/ duplicate.

findings.title: Inconsistent brand suffix and separator
findings.description: Mix of '- Phillip Strang', '— Phillip Strang', and none.
findings.recommendation: Standardize separator + brand string sitewide.

findings.title: Multiple H1s on some pages; missing og:description
findings.description: Homepage 3 H1s, series page 2 H1s; homepage OG lacks a description tag.
findings.recommendation: Tighten to one H1 per page; add og:description/twitter:description.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid Yoast JSON-LD graph sitewide (3/3 blocks parse)
Consistent Person/Organization/WebSite+SearchAction entity
Article schema on blog posts; BreadcrumbList everywhere

findings.title: Book pages have no Book/Product schema
findings.description: /cook/murder-house-phillip-strang/ emits only generic WebPage graph; no Book, Product, offers, author, or aggregateRating.
findings.recommendation: Add Book schema (author, isbn, bookFormat, inLanguage, workExample) and Offer/Product where price shown.

findings.title: List pages lack ItemList
findings.description: 'Books in order' / complete-book-list pages have no ItemList/ListItem markup for the books.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList with each item a Book for carousel eligibility and machine readability.

findings.title: No Review/AggregateRating
findings.description: No rating schema anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add AggregateRating/Review on book pages only where ratings are genuinely shown on-page.

findings.title: No FAQPage on guide content
findings.description: Reading-order pages answer discrete questions without FAQ markup.
findings.recommendation: Add small FAQPage blocks to aid AI extraction.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Cloudflare CDN + WordPress caching plugin
Moderate homepage payload (~87KB HTML, 14 scripts)

findings.title: Field CWV not measured (no API key)
findings.description: No CrUX/PageSpeed data available; score is a low-confidence estimate.
findings.recommendation: Configure Google PageSpeed/CrUX API key and re-run scripts/pagespeed_check.py.

findings.title: Image-heavy list templates risk LCP/CLS
findings.description: Series and 'books in order' pages load 19-31 cover images.
findings.recommendation: Serve WebP/AVIF with explicit width/height and lazy-loading below the fold.

findings.title: Page-builder CSS/JS bloat
findings.description: 11 inline style blocks suggest page-builder output that inflates CSS/DOM.
findings.recommendation: Audit render-blocking CSS/JS; defer non-critical scripts.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: AI-friendly content structure (clear headings, ordered lists, dated framing)
Strong author-entity signals via Person/Organization schema
Googlebot (and thus AI Overviews) still allowed

findings.title: Most AI crawlers blocked in robots.txt
findings.description: GPTBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent all Disallow: /; Content-Signal ai-train=no.
findings.recommendation: Set a deliberate policy: blocking training is fine, but consider allowing GPTBot/PerplexityBot so the brand can be CITED in AI answers (citation drives book discovery).

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt and /ai.txt 404.
findings.recommendation: Add llms.txt curating canonical high-value pages (complete book list, series hubs, about, free book).

findings.title: Strong citability untapped
findings.description: List content is ideal for AI citation but crawlers are blocked, so the value is unrealized off-Google.
findings.recommendation: After setting access policy, keep the existing extractable format.

categories.name: Images
what_works: ~94% alt-text coverage on sampled image-heavy page
og:image present with dimensions

findings.title: Confirm modern formats and explicit sizing
findings.description: Cover-heavy templates need WebP/AVIF, srcset, and width/height; file weights not measurable live.
findings.recommendation: Run an image-weight pass and convert/resize covers.

findings.title: A few missing alts; verify lazy-loading
findings.description: 2/31 images on the Rebus page lack alt; confirm loading=lazy below the fold.
findings.recommendation: Sweep templates for descriptive alt and lazy-loading.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Set WordPress Site Address to https:// so sitemaps emit https URLs
noindex lead-gen/thank-you/welcome/ARC pages and remove from sitemap
Resolve duplicate pages: 301 about-2, book-list-old, di-tremayne-series-2, *-old to canonical winners
Repair Yoast title template (eliminate dangling ' -'; end titles with '— Phillip Strang')
Add a single descriptive H1 to post/archive templates (fix 0-H1 pages)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add Book schema to all book pages; ItemList to 'books in order' pages
Decide AI-crawler citation policy; align robots.txt; add llms.txt
Write unique meta descriptions for series/category pages
Configure Google PageSpeed/CrUX API key and measure real CWV

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Audit 1,643 programmatic posts by depth; consolidate/noindex thinnest 20-30%
Strengthen competitor-author pages with original curation + internal links to Strang series
Convert cover images to WebP/AVIF with explicit dimensions + lazy-load
Add AggregateRating/Review and FAQPage where genuinely supported
Backlink profile review (configure Moz/Bing API for full data)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Search Console + GA4; track indexation after pruning
Capture an SEO drift baseline (scripts/drift_baseline.py) for change monitoring
Re-audit quarterly; monitor AI-Overview/ChatGPT citations after policy change
